29210-out-of-the-north.title: Out Of The North
29210-out-of-the-north.creator: Unknown
29210-out-of-the-north.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Who breathes upon it with the breath that makes it glow and die, Lighting that crystal river, those mountains cowl'd with snow? _In Winter_ Beneath the snow the mosses sleep Amid the forest's silence; Above, the stately birches keep Unbroken vigils. The spruce trees dream of summer hours And birds that carrolled sweetly, Of gentle winds and smiling flowers That died too quickly.

arxiv-1604-05184.title: Derivative with two fractional orders: New door of investigation
arxiv-1604-05184.creator: toward revolution in fractional calculus
arxiv-1604-05184.description: Abstract Abstract: In order to describe more complex problem using the concept of fractional derivative, we introduce in this paper a derivative with two fractional orders. Each order therefore plays an important rule while modeling for instance problems with two layers with different properties.

arxiv-2111-04767.title: On the Hydrogen Atom in the Holographic Universe Journal: Phys. Scr.
arxiv-2111-04767.creator: S. Jalalzadeh, S. Abarghouei Nejad, P.V. Moniz
arxiv-2111-04767.description: Abstract We investigate the holographic bound utilizing a homogeneous, isotropic, and non-relativistic neutral hydrogen gas present in the de Sitter space. Concretely, we propose to employ de Sitter holography intertwined with quantum deformation of the hydrogen atom using the framework of quantum groups.

arxiv-2201-12315.title: Galaxy flows within 8,000 km s -1 from Numerical Action methods
arxiv-2201-12315.creator: Edward J.Shaya, R. Brent Tully, Daniel Pomarède, Alan Peel
arxiv-2201-12315.description: Abstract The trajectories since z = 4 z=4 of systems of galaxies (‘halos’) with c ​ z < 8,000 cz<8,000 km s -1 are found through Numerical Action reconstructions. A set of 9,719 halos from a 2MASS group catalog and Cosmicflows-3 catalogs are given attention. Present distances are adjusted to minimize departures from observed redshifts.

arxiv-2205-12049.title: Duality in branched transport and urban planning
arxiv-2205-12049.creator: Julius Lohmann Bernhard Schmitzer Benedikt Wirth
arxiv-2205-12049.description: Abstract In recent work [ LSW22 , Theorem 1.3.4] we have shown the equivalence of the widely used nonconvex (generalized) branched transport problem with a shape optimization problem of a street or railroad network, known as (generalized) urban planning problem. The argument was solely based on an explicit construction and characterization of competitors.

arxiv-2301-06988.title: Dynamics of two air bubbles rising in a shear-thinning fluid
arxiv-2301-06988.creator: Purushotam Kumar, Surya P. Vanka
arxiv-2301-06988.description: Abstract In this paper, we have studied the three-dimensional dynamics of two equally sized air bubbles rising in a shear-thinning fluid. We have used the combined level set and volume of fluid (CLSVOF) method to track interface, maintain mass balance and estimate the interface curvature. Additionally, we have incorporated a Sharp Surface Force Method (SSF) for surface tension forces.

arxiv-2407-01171.title: Neural Conditional Probability for Uncertainty Quantification
arxiv-2407-01171.creator: Vladimir R. Kostic, Karim Lounici, Grégoire Pacreau, Giacomo Turri, Pietro Novelli, Massimiliano Pontil
arxiv-2407-01171.description: Abstract We introduce Neural Conditional Probability (NCP), an operator-theoretic approach to learning conditional distributions with a focus on statistical inference tasks. NCP can be used to build conditional confidence regions and extract key statistics such as conditional quantiles, mean, and covariance.

arxiv-2507-05390.title: From General to Specialized: The Need for Foundational Models in Agriculture
arxiv-2507-05390.creator: Vishal Nedungadi, Xingguo Xiong, Aike Potze, Ron Van Bree, Tao Lin, Marc Rußwurm, Ioannis N. Athanasiadis
arxiv-2507-05390.description: Abstract Food security remains a global concern as population grows and climate change intensifies, demanding innovative solutions for sustainable agricultural productivity. Recent advances in foundation models have demonstrated remarkable performance in remote sensing and climate sciences, and therefore offer new opportunities for agricultural monitoring.

arxiv-2509-22715.title: TRUEBench: Can LLM Response Meet Real-world Constraints as Productivity Assistant?
arxiv-2509-22715.creator: Jiho Park Jongyoon Song Minjin Choi Kyuho Heo Taehun Huh Ji Won Kim
arxiv-2509-22715.description: Abstract Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integral as productivity assistants, but existing benchmarks fall short in rigorously evaluating their real-world instruction-following capabilities. Current benchmarks often (i) lack sufficient multilinguality, (ii) fail to capture the implicit constraints inherent in user requests, and (iii) overlook the complexities of multi-turn dialogue.

arxiv-2512-03299.title: Degeneracy and Sato-Tate groups of y 2 = x p 2 − 1 y^{2}=x^{p^{2}}-1
arxiv-2512-03299.creator: Justin Chen, Heidi Goodson, Rezwan Hoque, Sabeeha Malikah
arxiv-2512-03299.description: Abstract . We say that an abelian variety is degenerate if its Hodge ring is not generated by divisor classes. Degeneracy leads to some interesting challenges when computing Sato-Tate groups, and there are currently few examples and techniques presented in the literature.

plos-pone-0005741.creator: Benjamin R. Myers, Yaron M. Sigal, David Julius
plos-pone-0005741.description: PLOS ONE research article. Animals sense changes in ambient temperature irrespective of whether core body temperature is internally maintained (homeotherms) or subject to environmental variation (poikilotherms). Here we show that a cold-sensitive ion channel, TRPM8, displays dramatically different thermal

pmc-11394619.title: Metformin Alleviates Inflammation and Induces Mitophagy in Human Retinal Pigment Epithelium Cells Suffering from Mitochondrial Damage
pmc-11394619.creator: Maija Toppila, Sofia Ranta-aho, Kai Kaarniranta, Maria Hytti, Anu Kauppinen, Valery Shestopalov
pmc-11394619.description: Mitochondrial malfunction, excessive production of reactive oxygen species (ROS), deficient autophagy/mitophagy, and chronic inflammation are hallmarks of age-related macular degeneration (AMD). Metformin has been shown to activate mitophagy, alleviate inflammation, and lower the odds of developing AMD. Here, we explored the ability of metformin to activate mitophagy and alleviate inflammation in retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) cells.

pmc-11398646.title: Immunogenicity and real-world effectiveness of COVID-19 vaccines in Lebanon: Insights from primary and booster schemes, variants, infections, and hospitalization
pmc-11398646.creator: Rima Moghnieh, Wajdi Haddad, Nayla Jbeily, Salam El-Hassan, Shadi Eid, Hicham Baba, Marilyne Sily, Yara Saber, Dania Abdallah, Abdul Rahman Bizri, Mohamed H. Sayegh
pmc-11398646.description: In this study, we conducted a case-control investigation to assess the immunogenicity and effectiveness of primary and first booster homologous and heterologous COVID-19 vaccination regimens against infection and hospitalization, targeting variants circulating in Lebanon during 2021–2022. The study population comprised active Lebanese military personnel between February 2021 and September 2022.

pmc-11453206.title: 6601 A Case of Recurrent Painless Thyroiditis and Discussion of Management
pmc-11453206.creator: Margaret Carolyn Slack, Shira Grock
pmc-11453206.description: Disclosure: M.C. Slack: None. S. Grock: None. Introduction: Painless (silent) thyroiditis is characterized as a subacute and generally self-limited disease process in which patients develop transient thyrotoxicosis, which is often followed by a hypothyroid phase before entering the recovery euthyroid phase. Given high frequency of positive thyroid antibodies, it may be autoimmune-mediated; recurrence is rare.

pmc-11657477.title: Project ECHO tele-mentoring primary care for individuals with IDD
pmc-11657477.creator: K.Jordan Kemere, Nital Appelbaum, Ellen Fremion
pmc-11657477.description: BackgroundAs the prevalence of intellectual and developmental disabilities (IDD) has increased over time, more youth with IDD will be transitioning into adult care. Individuals with IDD have a spectrum of behavioral, medical, adaptive, and home/community support needs depending on their cognitive ability, behavior concerns, mobility impairment, and/or medical complexity.

pmc-12519828.title: Nanotechnology-driven biofortification of Fe, Zn, and Se in edible plants
pmc-12519828.creator: Luana Vanessa Peretti Minello, Suelen Goettems Kuntzler, Emílio Berghahn, Liane Terezinha Dorneles, Felipe Klein Ricachenevsky, Raul Antonio Sperotto
pmc-12519828.description: Iron (Fe) and zinc (Zn) are essential micronutrients for both plants and humans, whereas selenium (Se) is essential for human health and beneficial for plants. Nevertheless, deficiencies in these elements remain a global concern. Nanoparticle (NP)-mediated biofortification of edible plants offers a sustainable and effective strategy to enhance crop nutritional value.

pmc-12607408.title: High-Throughput Screening of Industrial Brewing Yeast with Lower Synthetic Level of Acetaldehyde During Beer Production
pmc-12607408.creator: Shuangxin Han, Kecheng Sun, Xiaoping Hou, Xiujuan Wan, Jiahui Ding, Jianghua Li, Jian Chen, Guocheng Du, Xinrui Zhao, Hua Yin, Jose Antonio Couto
pmc-12607408.description: The high level of acetaldehyde produced by yeast is a significant concern for all enterprises of beer production. To obtain industrial beer yeast strains with low ability to produce acetaldehyde, a multi-step screening strategy was established, using Co60γ mutagenesis, high-throughput screening, and adaptive evolution.

pmc-12644733.title: Challenges and best practices when using ComBAT to harmonize diffusion MRI data
pmc-12644733.creator: Pierre-Marc Jodoin, Manon Edde, Gabriel Girard, Felix Dumais, Guillaume Theaud, Matthieu Dumont, Jean-Christophe Houde, Yoan David, Maxime Descoteaux, Michael W. Weiner, Michael W. Weiner, Paul Aisen, Ronald Petersen, Clifford R. Jack, William Jagust, Susan Landau, Monica Rivera-Mindt, Ozioma Okonkw
pmc-12644733.description: Over the years, ComBAT has become the standard method for harmonizing MRI-derived measurements, with its ability to compensate for site-related additive and multiplicative biases while preserving biological variability. However, ComBAT relies on a set of assumptions that, when violated, can result in flawed harmonization.

pmc-13190440.title: From wild shrub to cultivated host: a genetic roadmap for enhancing lac production in Flemingia semialata
pmc-13190440.creator: Jyotirmoy Ghosh, Vaibhav D. Lohot, Nawalesh Kumar Sinha, Vidyapati Vidyakar
pmc-13190440.description: The global demand for natural, biodegradable resins such as shellac is increasing, yet production remains severely constrained by reliance on genetically unimproved host plants. Flemingia semialata Roxb. has emerged as a superior perennial host for the lac insect (Kerria lacca) owing to its rapid growth, adaptability to marginal environments, and high resin yield potential.

pmc-13338967.title: Isolating transdiagnostic effects reveals specific genetic profiles in psychiatric disorders
pmc-13338967.creator: Engin Keser, Wangjingyi Liao, Andrea G. Allegrini, Kaili Rimfeld, Thalia C. Eley, Robert Plomin, Margherita Malanchini
pmc-13338967.description: BackgroundEvidence indicates substantial genetic overlap between psychiatric diagnoses. Accounting for these transdiagnostic effects can sharpen research on disorder‐specific genetic architecture and patterns of comorbidity.MethodsWe applied genomic structural equation modeling to genome‐wide association study summary statistics from 11 major psychiatric disorders to isolate genetic effects shared across disorders (the genomic p factor) from residual genetic effects associated with each disorder (non‐p).

pmc-13562522.title: Gut commensal Parabacteroides goldsteinii-derived CDCA mediates FXR signalling to improve mucosal barrier function
pmc-13562522.creator: Jiantao Yang, Kailong Qin, Qianggang Wang, Wei Guo, Xiaojun Yang
pmc-13562522.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The gut microbiome plays a crucial role in maintaining barrier integrity. However, it remains urgently needed to mining the gut microbiota that contribute to intestinal mucus barrier and to understand their biological mechanisms. In this study, the Lueyang black-boned chicken (LBC, a Chinese native breed) exhibited higher abundances of Bacteroidetes and Parabacteroides and stronger intestinal barrier function than Arbor Acres (AA, a commercial breed) broilers. Microbiota transplantation from LBC to AA broilers improved the intestinal barrier function.
